brief: A tall reinforced-concrete boiler stack of the harbour power plant, about 150 m high: a slender tapering pale grey concrete shaft with a blue-and-white banded top ring, standing on a stepped base beside the steel-framed boiler house, visible across the whole harbour. Three photos. Older than 1970 (1967): no West Coast harbour has built a tall stack since. Scaled to the lot; foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
